description: Ministry of Science & Technology Research - Subjects & Functions assigned to the State Minister of Science & Technology Research
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (SUSIL PREMAJAYANTHA, M.P., Minister of Science, Technology and Research) AND detailed descriptions of the specific subjects, functions, and responsibilities being assigned to the State Minister (provision of new inventions and technologies for rural communities, promotion of rural economy, implementation through Vidatha Resource Centers). This combination of a specific person with detailed portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
